xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2444: SageOx as an off-by-default skill pack, fork-first host-managed ox

plan.title: feat(agents): optional SageOx re-integration — session-reasoning capture for OSS projects (per-project opt-in, v0.11-era ox)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Operators want to try SageOx session capture without it taking over the repo. Upstream ox writes AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md markers and .claude/settings.json hooks on every prime, injects attribution, nags agents to run ox init, and uploads sessions by default. Overdeck removed it twice as a trust-boundary problem, and PAN-4334 currently refuses SageOx as a pack.
narratives.Proposal: Fork first: add an env-gated host-managed mode to eltmon/ox (no repo writes, no attribution, quiet when uninitialized, network off unless OX_HOST_NETWORK=on, a host-contract probe, a minimal init), PR'd inside the fork only. In Overdeck, make sageox a normal PAN-4334 pack sourced from eltmon/ox, off by default and toggled at global/project/issue level; when active on a Claude Code launch with .sageox/ present and a passing probe, the launch-settings step adds host-managed env and the six ox hooks to the --settings JSON. Uploads need a second per-project flag. Fail closed everywhere; disclose what leaves the machine in the UI and docs; doctor reports the binary state.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Any issue, PR or comment on sageox/* (upstream); upstreaming is the operator's later decision
- Force-pushing or rewriting the fork's main branch
- Overdeck running ox init, ox login or any upload command; pan install installing ox
- SageOx wiring for Codex, ohmypi, Kimi, ACP or remote (Fly) launches
- A local-only ledger that works without ox login + ox init, or a self-hosted ledger
- murmur, ox plan, carts, Ox Dot, or storing ox agent ids in Overdeck
- Turning the sageox pack on by default anywhere, or initializing SageOx in a commercial project (MYN)
- A dashboard control for the upload flag (CLI only in v1)
- Editing src/lib/projects.ts or growing any file above the 1000-line ceiling

autoDecisions.summary: The operator's 2026-09-29 fork-first comment supersedes revision 1 of the PRD; the PRD was rewritten, retiring FR-1..FR-3.
autoDecisions.rationale: The latest operator comment explicitly replaces the upstream-first plan and forbids upstream contact; revision 1 required an upstream PR.

autoDecisions.summary: Fork and Overdeck work stay in one plan, with fork items recording their results in docs/SAGEOX-FORK.md under Item: trailers.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator scoped the eltmon/ox work to this issue; eltmon/ox is not a registered Overdeck project, and pan task done checks trailers on the overdeck branch.

autoDecisions.summary: Fork PRs target a new fork branch overdeck-base at upstream v0.19.0; the stale fork main is untouched.
autoDecisions.rationale: Fork main is 1019 commits behind and 3 ahead; syncing it would need a force push, which is destructive and the operator's call.

autoDecisions.summary: The PAN-4334 pack toggle is the only opt-in; uploads need a separate per-project sageox_upload flag, default disabled.
autoDecisions.rationale: Operator: off by default, per-project/issue enable, nothing uploads unless explicitly enabled.

autoDecisions.summary: Claude Code only in v1; Codex launches exclude the sageox pack with a warning.
autoDecisions.rationale: Claude hooks can be injected through the existing --settings JSON; Codex hook injection without a committed .codex/hooks.json is unverified.

autoDecisions.summary: Overdeck fails closed unless `ox host-contract --json` answers overdeck-host/1 and .sageox/ exists at the git root.
autoDecisions.rationale: The host has upstream ox 0.2.0 on PATH; wiring hooks to an upstream binary would reintroduce repo writes and attribution.

autoDecisions.summary: Revision 1's agent_id storage and OX_EPHEMERAL split are dropped.
autoDecisions.rationale: ox agent ids must pass ox's own validator and Overdeck stores no derivable status; OX_EPHEMERAL disables the local ledger.

autoDecisions.summary: The KnownPack integration kind is removed and a skillsRoot hint is added so the plain adapter reads extensions/skills.
autoDecisions.rationale: The ox repo has no root plugin.json or skills/ dir, so neither adapter finds skills today; with sageox flipped, the integration kind has no users.

metadata.sizeJustification: Two-repo contract: the Overdeck launch wiring only has meaning against the fork's host-managed mode, and the operator scoped both halves to this issue. Fork paths (prefixed eltmon/ox:) inflate the subsystem and file counts; the Overdeck side alone is about 25 files across src/lib, src/cli, the dashboard frontend and docs.

Async host-contract probe for the ox binary

narrative.Action: PRD §8 O3 (D7, NFR-1). New src/lib/sageox/probe.ts: probeOxHostContract(opts?: { bin?: string; timeoutMs?: number }) returning { ok: true; version; commit } or { ok: false; reason: 'missing' | 'no-contract' | 'timeout' | 'bad-output' }. Use promisified execFile(bin ?? 'ox', ['host-contract', '--json'], { timeout: timeoutMs ?? 2000 }); never execSync. ENOENT ⇒ missing; non-zero exit ⇒ no-contract; killed by timeout ⇒ timeout; JSON without contract === 'overdeck-host/1' ⇒ bad-output. Tests in src/lib/sageox/__tests__/probe.test.ts use fake `ox` shell scripts written to a temp dir; the timeout case uses vi.useFakeTimers() with an injected exec function (fake timers do not drive real child processes).
